description: Provision a draft event in GuestDrop and generate an instant Stripe Checkout payment link for the host to complete booking. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'create_event_checkout' on GuestDrop Event Photo Album (guestdropalbum.com). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_pricing_and_packages' or 'calculate_event_cost' or 'recommend_scavenger_quests' for their respective operations). Parameters: event_name (required), host_name (required), host_email (required), tier (required), currency (optional), event_date (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Creates a live record/session in the backend database; no authentication required for public initiation; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

currency.description: Payment currency (ZAR or USD). Defaults to ZAR.

event_date.description: Optional date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

event_name.description: The title of the event (e.g. Sarah & David Wedding, Liam 30th Birthday Celebration). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

host_email.description: Email address of the event host for account access, album delivery, and receipt. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

host_name.description: Full name of the event organizer or couple. [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

tier.description: Selected event package tier (1day, 3day, or 7day). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].

name: create_event_checkout
title: Create Event Checkout
